notes: Phillip and Natalies' headstone, black marble, is located in Elmwood Cemetery just 30' north of the tree bearing section sign #12/259 via Hespeler road access. Refer also to Naturalization papers and birth certificate copies in Fingler Book.Phillip and Natalie were second cousins.There is confusion about the spelling of Fingler in this and many other cases.  When Phillip arrived in Canada his name was spelled Fangler with an umlaut over the a.  But this was changed on his Nat.and birth cert.documents to Fingler.
